name: 49686 · Traverse City, MI
findings: ZIP 49686 (Traverse City) has 161 nonprofit organizations. 65 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 53 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49686 (Traverse City) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
78% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
